source_pdfs.label: Public and Nonprofit Administration 2-Year Degree Map

faculty_override_note: The official 2025-2026 two-year map is the planning default. DegreeWorks and Business Management faculty advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: MAT 150 is shown on the official map; MAT 206 is an explicit alternative depending on the intended transfer institution.
SPE 102 may replace SPE 100 for non-native speakers of English.
PAN 100 is the prerequisite for PAN 230 and all 200-level PAN electives.
Choose three program electives from BUS 150, BUS 200, ECO 225, MAR 100, PAN 240, or PAN 250.
Choose the second Creative Expression course from the approved Pathways pool excluding SPE 100 and SPE 102.
The General Elective requirement is six credits; Common Core STEM excess may satisfy part of it.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
